about.title: About me
about.body1: I'm Jonathan, a full-stack developer. I like taking an idea, understanding the real problem behind it and turning it into a product people actually use.
about.body2: I work with React on the frontend and Node.js with Express on the backend, using PostgreSQL databases and third-party APIs. I keep code clear, tested and easy to maintain.
